proposals.before: Gao Jifu, Attendant Drafting the Secretariat, urged: 'Junior provincial officials are destitute; they ought to receive salaries to support their families.'
proposals.after: Gao Jifu, Attendant Drafting the Secretariat, urged: 'Junior provincial officials are destitute; they ought to receive salaries to support their parents.'
proposals.reason: Chinese 養親 means support parents/elders; idiomatic wrongly generalizes to families.

proposals.before: In Guangzai 1 (684), because eighth- and ninth-rank capital officials were poorly paid, the court granted eighth rank three general servants per year and ninth rank two.
proposals.after: In Guangzhai 1 (684), because eighth- and ninth-rank capital officials were poorly paid, the court granted eighth rank three general servants per year and ninth rank two.
proposals.reason: Reign name 光宅 is Guangzhai, not Guangzai.

proposals.before: Chancellor Yang Guozhong personally held several offices; beyond hall seals he was monthly given one million cash.
proposals.after: Chancellor Yang Guozhong personally held several offices; beyond hall-seal emoluments he was monthly given one million cash.
proposals.reason: 堂封 denotes chancellor seal/hall emoluments, not literal seals.

decisions.reason: Chinese 養親 specifically means supporting parents/elders, not households in general; replacing 'families' with 'parents' restores the source sense without other changes.
The reign title 光宅 is Guangzhai; 'Guangzai' is a pinyin error. The proposed spelling and year (684) match the Chinese era name.
堂封 is the chancellor's hall emolument, not physical seals; 'hall-seal emoluments' correctly marks it as a stipend term while staying close to the literal wording.
